name: Ichikawa (Hyōgo, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ichikawa town emblem in blue: an outlined ring of concentric lines with a pointed top, enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ichikawa, a town in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 July 1964.

features.role: Ichikawa town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines with a pointed top, enclosing a stylised character
